content:
Nuno Mangas, President of Compete, spoke with BUILT CoLAB on 19 July about what can be expected from PT2030, whose applications are expected to open shortly.

This testimony from Nuno Mangas was gathered at the end of the Interim Conference of the SIAC FoC – Future of Construction project, where he was present, and which addressed the theme "The Strategy for the Sustainable Future of Construction".
